remarks: *DO NOT USE THE WORKING FILES - USE THE FILE IN THE SOFTWARE 1RU FOLDER

notes: All products with EPC1S need to be programmed with Quartus on the Lab computer. If the program says license has expired press "Run Quartus Software" to bypass the license setup. Goto "Tools" and then "Programmer". Once in programmer, select "Active Serial Programming" instead of "JTAG". The file has an extension POF. Press Open File and and look for the file in the proper location.
All products with the Lattice LFXP3C device need to be programmed with LSC ispVM® on the Lab computer. Programming instructions are as follows:
i. Open LSC ispVM software
ii. Close 'Chain Configuration' window
iii. Click the 'Scan' button on tool bar
iv. Ensure that the device under 'Device List' corresponds to the device being programmed
v. Double click the 'FileName/IR-Length' field to open the firmware file
vi. Under 'Data File' click the 'Browse' button to look for the file in the proper location. The file will have a .JED extension.
vii. After choosing the file, click the 'OK' button in the 'Device Information' window
viii. You will be brought back to the 'New Scan Configuration Setup' window. Click the 'GO' button on the tool bar to begin programming.

Use ChipWin to program the EEPROMS, if AT25F512 use the VISUAL DSP++ (SEE BELOW FOR INSTRUCTIONS). The file has an extension LDR. Press Open File and type (*.ldr) in the file name box and look in the debug folder

If using the VISUAL DSP++ Flash Programmer, Select Session ADSP-21262. Select Tools --> Flash Programmer. Select Driver (/Visual DSP 4.0/212xx/Flash Programmer Drivers/ADSP-21262 EZ-KIT LITE/AT25F512/AT25F512.EXE. Press Load Driver. Select the LDR file you want to load. Press Load File.
The software history of each openGear card is kept in its own software folder.
